title: Integral homology lattices of matching and circulant complexes
summary: Bouc's hook cycles span the rational top homology of the matching complex of $K_{2k+1}$. We prove that their integral saturation quotient has exponent exactly $2^{\lfloor k/2\rfloor}$ for every $k\geq1$, and construct divided-power cycles attaining this bound. For $k\geq2$, the homology lattice is not isomorphic to the standard integral hook lattice as an $\mathfrak S_{2k+1}$-module. For circulant complexes, we determine the integral dihedral homology modules of $\operatorname{Ind}(C_{3s}^{s-1})$, $\operatorname{Ind}(C_{3s+1}^{s-1})$ and $\operatorname{Ind}(C_{3s+2}^{s-1})$, for $s\geq3$,…
